coverageNote: First-light pass — AU/NZ only. Purpose: identify recurring primary/secondary press sources that surface startup funding rounds, major customer wins, and milestone announcements — the raw material for a future daily/periodic scan feeding Scout. Not yet wired to any cron or Scout mechanism. Standalone Pipeline reference tab only.

sources.name: Startup Daily
sources.focus: Sector-agnostic AU/NZ startup news — funding rounds, accelerator cohorts, M&A, policy
sources.fundingCoverage: Strong — dedicated Funding tag/archive (startupdaily.net/topic/funding/), covers seed through Series C+ rounds with amounts, investors, and founder names
sources.signalQuality: High — long-running dedicated masthead (formerly StartupSmart-adjacent lineage), first-party interviews with founders/investors common, not just wire reposts
sources.accessNotes: Free, no paywall observed on funding posts
sources.sourceNotes: startupdaily.net official site, confirmed live and actively publishing (posts dated within past 2 weeks at check time, 27 Aug 2026).

sources.name: SmartCompany StartupSmart
sources.focus: Sector-agnostic, strong on weekly funding round-ups
sources.cadence: Daily, with a recurring weekly 'X startups that raised $Y million this week' round-up format
sources.fundingCoverage: Very strong — the weekly round-up format is exactly the pattern-matchable structure a scan needs (explicit $ amounts, company names, sector tags per round, published weekly)
sources.signalQuality: High — long-running masthead, weekly round-up is low-noise and highly structured, good candidate for the first automated pass
sources.accessNotes: Some SmartCompany content is subscription-gated; startup-specific round-ups have historically been accessible
sources.sourceNotes: smartcompany.com.au/startupsmart confirmed live, weekly round-up format observed consistently across multiple 2026 posts (Mar, Apr, Jul editions checked).

sources.name: Australian Financial Review — Start-ups & Start-up Funding topics
sources.focus: Sector-agnostic, skews toward larger/later-stage rounds and named-VC deal coverage
sources.fundingCoverage: Strong on larger rounds (Series B+) and anything with investor-name signal value; less reliable for small pre-seed/seed rounds that don't clear the AFR newsworthiness bar
sources.signalQuality: High trust, lower volume — AFR is a primary-tier masthead so anything it reports is well-corroborated, but it won't catch the long tail of small raises
sources.accessNotes: Paywalled — AFR requires subscription for full articles; headlines/summaries visible without login
sources.sourceNotes: afr.com/topic/start-ups-629 and /topic/start-up-funding-1mqn confirmed live and actively updated.

sources.name: InnovationAus
sources.focus: Deep tech, government funding programs, R&D policy, university spinouts — heavier policy/government angle than pure funding-round reporting
sources.fundingCoverage: Moderate for private-round announcements; strong for government grant/program announcements (complements Pipeline's existing federal/state coverage rather than duplicating Scout's company-discovery need)
sources.signalQuality: High trust for policy and deep-tech-adjacent stories; less useful as a pure company-funding feed
sources.sourceNotes: innovationaus.com — already used as a primary source in this Pipeline dataset (e.g. UNSW/USyd pre-seed fund entries). Cross-referenced here for completeness.

sources.name: Business Desk NZ — Startups
sources.focus: Sector-agnostic NZ startup and early-stage tech news
sources.fundingCoverage: Good — covers NZ funding rounds across agritech, fintech, gaming, open banking specifically per own site description
sources.signalQuality: Moderate-high — dedicated NZ business masthead, credible but smaller volume than AU equivalents given NZ's smaller startup ecosystem
sources.accessNotes: Partial paywall — BusinessDesk has a subscription model, some articles free
sources.sourceNotes: businessdesk.co.nz/startups confirmed live, explicit self-description as NZ startup/early-stage news vertical.

sources.name: NZ Herald — Startup topic
sources.focus: Sector-agnostic, mixes startup profiles with general small-business content
sources.cadence: Irregular — not a dedicated startup desk, topic tag aggregates from general newsroom
sources.fundingCoverage: Weak-moderate — funding rounds appear but are mixed in with general small business/human-interest startup profiles, lower signal-to-noise than BusinessDesk
sources.signalQuality: Moderate — mainstream masthead credibility, but not a specialist source so requires more filtering
sources.sourceNotes: nzherald.co.nz/topic/startup/ confirmed live; content sampled skews toward founder profile pieces over hard funding announcements.

sources.name: Fintech Australia / FinTech News Australia
sources.type: Sector-specific trade body + affiliated trade press
sources.focus: Fintech-only — funding rounds, ecosystem maps, 'startups to watch' lists
sources.cadence: Regular, several posts/week (fintechnews.au); trade body site more static/directory-style
sources.fundingCoverage: Good within fintech vertical only — not useful for B2B pipe companies outside fintech, but high-precision within the vertical if Scout's lens includes payment-flow fintech
sources.signalQuality: Moderate-high within niche — sector specialists tend to catch fintech raises mainstream press misses, but zero coverage outside the vertical
sources.sourceNotes: fintechaustralia.org.au (trade body, ecosystem map + directory) and fintechnews.au (news arm, confirmed live with 2026-dated funding content) both checked.

sources.name: Tracxn — Australia / New Zealand geography pages
sources.type: Startup data platform (aggregator, not editorial press)
sources.focus: Sector-agnostic, structured funding-round database with dollar totals, deal counts, and company-level records
sources.cadence: Continuously updated database, not a publication cadence
sources.fundingCoverage: Very strong on structured data (deal counts, $ totals by period) but individual company profiles/deal detail often gated behind paid tiers
sources.signalQuality: High for aggregate market signal (e.g. '$1.77B raised in 82 rounds YTD June 2026'); lower for actionable per-company detail without a paid subscription
sources.accessNotes: Freemium — headline stats free, full company/deal database gated
sources.sourceNotes: tracxn.com confirmed live with current 2026 AU ($1.77B/82 rounds YTD June) and NZ ($10.5B all-time, 37.6K startups, 2 unicorns) aggregate figures. Useful as a market-sizing cross-check, not a primary discovery feed.

periodicLists.name: AFR BOSS Most Innovative Companies
periodicLists.focus: Cross-sector — companies judged on genuine innovation, not just funding size or headcount
periodicLists.cadence: Annual (15th year running as of 2026, published around Oct/Nov)
periodicLists.fundingCoverage: N/A — not a funding-round source. Value is qualitative: identifies companies doing something real enough to pass third-party judging
periodicLists.signalQuality: High — judged by Inventium (behavioural science consultancy) with Cognizant as methodology partner, genuine external judging panel rather than a press release or self-nomination list
periodicLists.accessNotes: Paywalled (AFR subscription) — Andrew has premium login, will provide article/PDF text on request since no automated login is available
periodicLists.pullMethod: Manual — Chappie flags when the annual list drops, Andrew or Neera pastes/forwards the article or PDF
periodicLists.sourceNotes: afr.com/lists-and-awards/most-innovative-companies confirmed live, 2026 edition referenced as 15th year. Judging methodology confirmed via multiple sources (AFR own methodology piece, LinkedIn showcase page).

periodicLists.name: AFR Young Rich List
periodicLists.focus: Wealthiest Australians under 40 — many entries are founders, useful for spotting who's building something big enough to generate personal wealth, even pre-major-funding-news
periodicLists.fundingCoverage: Indirect — doesn't report rounds directly but flags founders worth searching individually for their company's funding history
periodicLists.signalQuality: Moderate-high — AFR editorial rigour on wealth verification, but skews toward already-successful/later-stage founders rather than early discovery
periodicLists.accessNotes: Paywalled — same access approach as Most Innovative Companies
periodicLists.pullMethod: Manual — annual pull, cross-reference new names against existing Scout/Pipeline coverage
periodicLists.sourceNotes: afr.com/young-rich confirmed live, 2025 edition referenced 22 new faces including AI-sector founders (per bosshunting.com.au coverage of the same list).

periodicLists.name: AFR Fast Starters
periodicLists.type: Curated annual list, ranked by hard metric
periodicLists.focus: Companies ranked explicitly by revenue CAGR — the cleanest, most quantifiable filter of the three AFR lists for "is this company actually growing fast"
periodicLists.fundingCoverage: Indirect — revenue growth signal rather than funding-round data, but arguably a stronger "real traction" signal than a funding announcement alone
periodicLists.signalQuality: High for the specific thing it measures (revenue CAGR ranking) — least subjective of the three AFR lists since it's not judged/curated, it's ranked by a number
periodicLists.accessNotes: Paywalled — same access approach as the other two AFR lists
periodicLists.pullMethod: Manual — annual pull, high-priority cross-check against Scout's B2B pipe/seed-Series A lens given the clean growth-rate filter
periodicLists.sourceNotes: afr.com/lists-and-awards/fast-starters confirmed live; example entry found (Kismet Healthcare, 4630% CAGR) demonstrates the ranking methodology is genuinely metric-driven, not editorial pick.

candidatesNotYetVerified.name: Startup Muster
candidatesNotYetVerified.note: Referenced by FinTech Australia as Australia's national startup survey (annual, not a news feed) — worth checking as an annual milestone/data-release trigger rather than a recurring news source. Not deep-dived this pass.

candidatesNotYetVerified.name: Which-50
candidatesNotYetVerified.note: AU digital economy trade press, mentioned in search results as adjacent to InnovationAus/Fintech Australia coverage set — not independently verified live this pass, flag for next iteration.
